scope: Grounded stationary ideal stereo rig; 1, 2, 4 m saved validation worlds
insufficient_diagnostic_region_policy: not_observed; required regions must pass in at least one accepted scene in the combined report
notes: Version 3 records a diagnostic region with <50 visible pixels as not_observed, not passed. The 1 m occluded strip falls entirely outside the shared camera view. Combined acceptance must observe and pass each required confidence region in at least one scene. No numeric error/coverage/confidence threshold is relaxed. Version 2 increased low-texture erosion from 8 to 15 px to account for the 31x9 support footprint; baseline versions/results remain preserved. Cached reference requires the declared stationary-pose bounds; this evaluator is unsuitable for flight.
